notes: Primary method: reconstructed Airbnb's own search API results by fetching dated search URLs (checkin=2026-12-19, checkout=2026-12-27, min_bedrooms=6, entire-home) via curl and parsing the embedded data-deferred-state JSON. This returned real 8-night totals, coordinates, bed configurations and image URLs for the exact trip dates — 32 dated searches across Tampa, St. Petersburg, Clearwater, Dunedin, Palm Harbor, Safety Harbor, Tarpon Springs, Oldsmar, Temple Terrace, Apollo Beach, Riverview, Tierra Verde, Largo, Seminole, Gulfport, Ruskin, Lutz, Odessa plus neighborhood-level queries (Davis Islands, Snell Isle, Shore Acres, Old Northeast, Hyde Park, South Tampa, Seminole Heights, Ybor City, Westshore). 239 unique listings collected; 65 were 6-8BR inside the region bounding box; the best 20 were individually fetched and enriched with per-bedroom bed configs, amenity lists and descriptions. BLOCKED: WebFetch returned 403 on airbnb.com and byowner.com and 429 on expedia.com/vrbo.com (curl with a browser user-agent worked on Airbnb and Vrbo, which is how the data above was obtained). HomeToGo bedroom-filter URLs 404. COVERAGE GAPS: Davis Islands, Snell Isle, Old Northeast, Shore Acres and Tierra Verde returned essentially no 6-8BR entire-home inventory for these dates — those are owner-occupied luxury neighborhoods with almost no large short-term rental stock, which is a real finding rather than a search failure. Local PM companies (Florida Vacation Collection 813-343-2660, Florida Sun Vacation Rentals, Vacasa Tampa) publish no browsable 6+ bedroom inventory online for this region and would need phone calls. PRICES: all Airbnb totals are pre-tax/pre-fee 8-night totals quoted by Airbnb for Dec 19-27 2026.

properties.cons: No published price and no published bed configuration, so both budget and the king-bed question are unresolved. Palm River–Clair Mel is a modest neighborhood, and the pool is only cleaned once weekly per the listing.
